credit_boundary: Every failure remains zero credit; each bounded recovery is a separate passing witness and never rewrites the failed event.

failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A broad final-template source projection exceeded the available presentation boundary and produced no complete attributable read.
failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Exact fixed-string searches followed by bounded line windows recovered only the final seal and closeout-witness dependencies without mutation.
